How to write better emails with AI: who, what, tone, length

"Write an email to a supplier about a late delivery" gets you "I hope this email finds you well" and a [Supplier Name] blank. Polite, vague, not ready to send.

Give it 4 things instead:

"Write an email to [WHO + HOW YOU KNOW THEM]. What: [WHAT HAPPENED + WHAT YOU NEED]. Tone: [E.G. FRIENDLY BUT FIRM]. Length: under [N] words."

I filled it in for an example bakery chasing a late flour order and got 5 short lines: what's missing, the Friday deadline, what happens if not, and a clear ask. Ready to send after a quick read.

Tip: length is the one people skip. A word limit cuts the waffle.

Send this to someone who still writes every email from scratch. Follow @nomorebusywork for one fix a day.
